items.label: QUICK-DRY & DURABLE
items.value: Polyester webbing upper is extremely durable and dries quickly after getting wet.

items.label: CAMFORTABLE & CASUAL
items.value: Casual walking water sandals for women, Adjustable straps for secure fit.

items.label: EVA FOOTBED & ARCH SUPPORT
items.value: The cushiony EVA yoga mat insole can absorb the impact. The arch support built into the sandal can help provide support to the foot while standing. It can also help control the foot and restrict excess pronation during the gait cycle.

items.label: INGENIOUS DESIGN
items.value: Featuring hook-and-loop closures with padded heel strap makes it comfortable to wear and easy to adjust the tightness for a better fit.

items.label: ANTISKID OUTSOLE
items.value: Soft & skid-resistant rubber outsole gives you safe and secure footing and prevents from abrasion and slip.
